description: Canonical two-turn conversation script for manually exercising the voice-agent demo, including one barge-in. Read aloud (or piped as recorded audio) to a real /v2/listen session while examples/voice-agent's cordis.yml composition is running.

turns.speaker: user
turns.say: Hi there, can you give me a two sentence summary of what a barge-in is in a voice agent?
turns.expect: The agent starts speaking a short definition.

turns.speaker: user
turns.say: Actually, never mind — what's the weather like on Mars?
turns.timing: Interrupt the agent mid-sentence, partway through its first answer.
turns.expect: TurnController.bargeIn() fires: playback halts immediately, the in-flight LLM call aborts, TtsSession.interrupt() reports the session-wide playback offset, and speech-agent/turn-interrupted logs the exact textSpoken/textRemaining split.

turns.speaker: user
turns.expect: The agent answers the Mars-weather question in full this time (no further barge-in) and speech-agent/turn-completed logs its billing and timing.
